topic: gpui-fast port (perf-cache): retained steady-state frames vs from-scratch frames
method: Headless window per scenario, warmed, then per iteration one small change + one full draw. Each scenario runs with Window::set_view_retention(true) vs (false); (false) is upstream GPUI's drawing model on the same build, so the pair isolates retention. LayoutStats deltas are over 10 warm frames after reset_layout_stats().
environment_note: Same machine/session as the run recorded here; absolute times are for pair comparison, regenerate via scripts/qa_perf_baseline.py for the committed baseline.

pairs.scenario: panels_one_change (60 panel entities, one notified per frame)
pairs.note: Post stage-4b run: text carry/replay also speeds the from-scratch arm (941us before 4b), so the retained pair ratio narrows while both arms get faster in absolute terms.

pairs.scenario: showcase_table_refresh (gpui-showcase Table section, root notified per frame)

notes: Retained layout nodes are active in both arms (nodes_reused is high in both); the pair isolates retained views/splicing + list layers.

Div tile layers are gated off in real apps until a renderer calls gpui::set_tile_layers_supported(true); list layers need no tiles and are on. The uniform_list pair therefore understates the div-container case gpui-fast measures on its own renderers.
